manaNeeded: {R}{R} plus the cost of the additional sorcery
notablePrerequisites: You have an additional castable sorcery.
description:
Cast any sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost.
Kalamax's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Increasing Vengeance and choosing to copy the original Increasing Vengeance.
Resolve the second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kalamax.
Resolve the Increasing Vengeance copy, creating a copy of Increasing Vengeance.
Kalamax's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.
